body.message:
Pest control is the responsibility of the property management. Whether insects are found or not, it is your responsibility to carry out regular pest control and maintain the apartment in a proper condition.
If bed bugs were actually present, I would be the one with the right to complain because I was provided with an apartment that allegedly had bed bugs. Their presence alone does not make me responsible for them, and it certainly does not justify charging me for your pest control cost
